tldr: Mars through the 3rd house heats up messages, conversations, learning, and daily movement.
body:
When Mars moves through your 3rd house, it adds heat and urgency to messages, conversations, errands, siblings, neighbors, learning, planning, and what needs to be said. You may notice more activity in your immediate world: conversations to have, details to track, short trips to make, or a decision that needs clearer words.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for naming the thing that has been circling in your mind.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is getting scattered by every message, detail, or possible interpretation.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
